pr_title: Ignore identical BeanDefinition registration when allowBeanDefinitionOverriding is false
pr_comment: @rilmay Thank you for signing the [Contributor License Agreement](https://cla.pivotal.io/sign/spring?repositoryId=spring-projects/spring-framework&pullRequestId=27986)!
@jhoeller, I've assigned this to you since you assigned #27978 to yourself recently.

review_comment:
That is dangerous. It can hide redefinition that are not identical if `isAllowBeanDefinitionOverriding()` returns false. e.g. X is defined, then X' (same name, different definition) is defined somewhere else. Whether X or X' are used is, sometimes, a matter of loading order which can be unpredictable.
If `isAllowBeanDefinitionOverriding()` is false then the desire of the developer is often to be notified about such cases and not hide them (at least that was the behavior until now).
